title: How Warren Buffet Built His Legacy By Finding Value No One Else Could See – Rerun

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: With the news of Warren Buffett stepping down as chairman of Berkshire Hathaway.
reader_summary.overview: With the news of Warren Buffett stepping down as chairman of Berkshire Hathaway, we are revisiting an episode from our two-part series on Buffet. Warren Buffett rose from obscurity to become the richest person in the world - and he did it in a unique way. As a boy in Omaha he collected information obsessively - writing down car license numbers and hoarding bottle caps.

key_points.text: As a young man, Buffett turned his focus on scouring business accounts to find companies that had hidden value no one else could spot.
We tell the story of young Warren Buffett as he quietly worked building up the expertise and accumulating the wealth that would allow him to become the most famous investor of our age..
